subject: Call recap: inference unit-cost pressure & pilot scope
messages:
From: Sam Tan <sam.tan@clearledger.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 14:11:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + quick call re: inference costs

Thanks Chloe — good to meet briefly earlier. A couple quick notes so we can make the call productive:
- We're running self-hosted LLM endpoints on GCP (NVIDIA A100s), traffic average ~10M tokens/day, bursts up to 40M.
- Average prompt+response ~3.5k tokens; 95th pctl latency ~450ms (not great for product UX).
- Main ask: reduce per-token cost without sacrificing output quality for our refund/triage workflows.
- We're open to batching/caching and quantization but need clear eval criteria (quality delta tolerances).

Attaching a simple infra snapshot: infra-diagram.png (image/png).

Sam
Sam Tan | Head of AI Platforms | ClearLedger
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Tan <sam.tan@clearledger.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + quick call re: inference costs

Hi Sam — thanks for the call and for the infra snapshot. Quick recap here so we all have the same success criteria and next steps. Please flag anything I missed.

High-level pain points you shared:
- Unit economics: current cost per 1k tokens is a blocker for expanding to higher-volume flows (refund/triage ingestion).
- Latency tail: 95th pctl ~450ms impacts UX and throughput for synchronous flows.
- Ops overhead: maintaining model variants and tuning quantization in-house is delaying feature work.
- Compliance: must preserve PII handling and have SOC2-compatible evidence for any external partner.

Current stack (from what you described + infra diagram):
- Cloud: GCP (us-west1)
- Hardware: A100 fleet, mixed generations, autoscaling via instance groups
- Serving: internal REST endpoints, limited KV caching, batch size typically 1–4 due to latency constraints
- Model: mix of open LLMs (7B–13B) and a few pruned fine-tuned variants

Success criteria for a pilot (you approved the rough thresholds during the call):
- Cost: reduce effective token cost by 20–35% (end-to-end) vs current baseline within pilot window.
- Latency: 95th pctl response time <= 300ms for the sampled production traffic profile.
- Quality: automated evals + 50-shot human spot checks with <= 2% degradation on critical response metrics (precision for triage tags).
- Ops: turnkey pipeline for rolling quantization/variant testing and rollback in under 30 minutes.

Proposed pilot scope (4–6 weeks):
1) Week 0–1: onboarding + baseline measurement (we'll run a lightweight profiler against a mirrored traffic sample).
2) Week 1–3: batching/caching configuration + quantized variant tests (we'll run 1–2 quantization levels and compare quality).
3) Week 3–4: throughput/latency tuning and guardrail tests (SLO verification).
4) Week 5: readout and recommended production rollout plan (including cost/latency tradeoffs).

What we need from ClearLedger to start:
- A 48–72h mirror of representative traffic (or a sanitized sample) for baseline profiling.
- Confirmation that one non-PII production endpoint can be mirrored to our test pool, or a dataset export.
- Procurement contact for pilot agreement (email for billing/PO).

Attachments I dropped into the Drive link and attached here:
- redwood_pilot_template.xlsx — pilot milestones and responsibilities
- ROI_modeling_template.xlsx — quick model for unit-cost comparison
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf — summary of controls and evidence we can provide

Next steps (tentative):
- Sam: confirm procurement contact + whether you can provide a mirrored sample by Mon 11/1.
- Chloe/Aditya: we'll draft the pilot SOW and share a short kickoff agenda.
- Monica: I'll loop you in for ops/implementation scheduling (you'll be the primary SE).

Thanks again — we're excited to see if we can hit the cost + latency targets without sacrificing quality.

Cheers,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

From: Sam Tan <sam.tan@clearledger.com>

Cc: Priya Rao <priya@clearledger.com>, procure@clearledger.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + quick call re: inference costs

Chloe — this is great, thanks for laying it out. A few quick confirmations:
- Procurement contact: procure@clearledger.com (Priya is the PO owner).
- We can provide a sanitized 72h traffic dump by end-of-day Mon 11/1 — it will need a short internal review first.
- We're happy for Redwood to run profiling against a mirrored endpoint in a test project (we'll give limited access keys).

On quantization: engineering is conservative but open to 8-bit and per-channel tests as long as we can automatically compare model outputs against the golden set. We'll ask data science to prepare the golden set this week.

Let's plan a 30-minute kickoff next Tuesday 11/2 at 10am PT — propose: Chloe + Aditya (Redwood), Monica (ops), Sam + Priya (ClearLedger), and one eng from DS to own the golden-set validation.

Sam
